name: commit-msg
description: /commit-msg drafts a commit message from the staged diff, following the repo's format file or its recent history, then commits or amends (never pushes)

format_files.title: Format files (default: .claude/commit-format.md, .github/commit-format.md)
format_files.description: Comma-separated paths, relative to the repo root, to a file of commit message rules. The first one that exists is used; with none, the draft follows the style of the recent commits

model.title: Model (default: sonnet)
model.description: Model that drafts the message and merges it into HEAD's on an amend

exclude.title: Excluded paths (default: .idea)
exclude.description: Comma-separated git pathspecs left out of the diff the drafter reads and of the not-staged list (they are still committed when staged)

history.title: Recent messages (default: 10)
history.description: How many recent commit messages the drafter reads for the house style

max_file_chars.title: Diff cap per file (default: 12000)
max_file_chars.description: Characters of each file's diff the drafter reads, so one generated file (a lockfile, an OpenAPI spec) cannot crowd out the rest
